jobs.name: inject-header
jobs.command: cp -f runs/sweep-tmp/duck_model.h experimental/duck_cuda/include/duck_model.h && grep DW_PHASE_HZ experimental/duck_cuda/include/duck_model.h | tee injected-phase.txt

jobs.name: gpu-info
jobs.command: nvidia-smi | tee gpu-info.txt && nvcc --version | tee -a gpu-info.txt

jobs.name: train
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; $PY -B -m walk.train.gpu_train --envs 4096 --horizon 64 --updates 99999 --seed 917 --device cuda --library $(find experimental/duck_cuda -name 'libduck_cuda_fast.so' | head -1) --lane-env --out gpu-train-out --resume runs/sweep-tmp/warmstart.pt --lr 1.5e-4 --max-wall-s 780 2>&1 | tee gpu-train.log
